Strategy: Prefer leftovers that fit odd counts. A leftover holding an odd number of same-size items keeps one slot open beyond whole pairs, while even counts close in pairs. Score by leftover with a bonus when it fits an odd number of same-size items, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to an odd band. Exact fits rank top. It may help by keeping slots open, but may fail because the odd-even split is arbitrary and later items rarely repeat.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if ((r - item) // item) % 2 == 1 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Odd-count band bonus: +item when leftover fits an odd number of same-size items.
